data.content:
Integration Structure

Order Pushing

We instantly transmit orders to the restaurants affiliated to your company, you must provide us with 2 separate URLs for new order and order cancellation and a special x-api-key for Getir for secure communication. The x-api-key value must be the same for both urls. All order information will be sent by POST method to the URLs provided by you. 

Here's an example of a webhook URL and payload:

New Order 

Url: https://yourdomain.com/newOrder

Payload:

{
  "id": ObjectId,
  "status": enum,
  "isScheduled": boolean,
  "confirmationId": string,
  "client": {
    "id": ObjectId,
    "name": string,
    "contactPhoneNumber": string,
    "clientPhoneNumber": "+90 (850) 000-00000 / 000000", // string
    "deliveryAddress": {
      "id": ObjectId,
      "address": string,
      "aptNo": string,
      "floor": string,
      "doorNo": string,
      "city": string,
      "district": string,
      "description": string
    },
    "location": {
      "lat": double,
      "lon": double
    }
  },
  "courier": {
    "id": ObjectId,
    "status": enum,
    "name": string,
    "location": {
      "lat": float,
      "lon": float
    }
  },
  "products": [
    {
      "id": ObjectId,
      "imageURL": string,
      "wideImageURL": string,
      "count": double,
      "product": string,
      "name": {
        "tr": string,
        "en": string
      },
      "price": double,
      "optionPrice": double,
      "priceWithOption": double,
      "totalPrice": double,
      "totalOptionPrice": double,
      "totalPriceWithOption": double,
      "optionCategories": [],
      "displayInfo": {
        "title": {
          "tr": string,
          "en": string
        },
        "options": {
          "tr": [],
          "en": []
        }
      },
      "note": string,
      "discountedPriceWithOption": double,
      "totalDiscountedPriceWithOption": double
    }
  ],
  "clientNote": string,
  "doNotKnock": boolean,
  "dropOffAtDoor": boolean,
  "totalPrice": double,
  "totalDiscountedPrice": double,
  "checkoutDate": datetime,
  "deliveryType": integer,
  "isEcoFriendly": boolean,
  "paymentMethod": double,
  "paymentMethodText": {
    "en": string,
    "tr": string
  },
  "restaurant": {
    "id": ObjectId,
    "name": string,
    "brand": {}
  },
  "isQueued": boolean
}

Cancel Order

Url: https://yourdomain.com/cancelOrder

Payload:

{
  "id": ObjectId,
  "status": enum,
  "isScheduled": boolean,
  "confirmationId": string,
  "client": {
    "id": ObjectId,
    "name": string,
    "contactPhoneNumber": string,
    "clientPhoneNumber": "+90 (850) 000-00000 / 000000", // string
    "deliveryAddress": {
      "id": ObjectId,
      "address": string,
      "aptNo": string,
      "floor": string,
      "doorNo": string,
      "city": string,
      "district": string,
      "description": string
    },
    "location": {
      "lat": double,
      "lon": double
    }
  },
  "courier": {
    "id": ObjectId,
    "status": enum,
    "name": string,
    "location": {
      "lat": float,
      "lon": float
    }
  },
  "products": [
    {
      "id": ObjectId,
      "imageURL": string,
      "wideImageURL": string
      "count": double,
      "product": string,
      "name": {
        "tr": string,
        "en": string
      },
      "price": double,
      "optionPrice": double,
      "priceWithOption": double,
      "totalPrice": double,
      "totalOptionPrice": double,
      "totalPriceWithOption": double,
      "optionCategories": [],
      "displayInfo": {
        "title": {
          "tr": string,
          "en": string
        },
        "options": {
          "tr": [],
          "en": []
        }
      },
      "note": string,
      "discountedPriceWithOption": double,
      "totalDiscountedPriceWithOption": double
    }
  ],
  "clientNote": string,
  "doNotKnock": boolean,
  "dropOffAtDoor": boolean,
  "totalPrice": double,
  "totalDiscountedPrice": double,
  "checkoutDate": datetime,
  "verifyDate": datetime,
  "cancelDate": datetime,
  "cancelNote": string,
  "cancelReason": {
    "id": string,
    "messages": {
      "tr": string,
      "en": string
    },
    "cancelSource": integer
  },
  "deliveryType": enum,
  "isEcoFriendly": boolean,
  "paymentMethod": integer,
  "paymentMethodText": {
    "en": string,
    "tr": string
  },
  "restaurant": {
    "id": ObjectId,
    "name": string,
    "brand": {}
  },
  "isQueued": boolean
}

Order Inquiry for Backup

In cases where you cannot handle the order data we have sent to you, you can query your orders via the /unapproved endpoint. Alternatively, you can query the /active endpoint.

You should not constantly query the /unapproved endpoint.
